recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing authoritative source portion of FHIR-35168 while respecting the generated-artifact guardrail; generated diagrams should be refreshed by the normal build pipeline if they are published.
issue_request: FHIR-35168 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked for the fhirVersion definitions in StructureDefinition and ImplementationGuide to be clarified because the old [publication].[major].[minor] wording and revision-number language did not match the FHIR version policy, and also requested related versioning-page cleanup.
initial_application: Historical commit 6f6a8881881a31a2ec13ae9d185200556d161b53 applied the versioning-page, HTTP, FHIRVersion code system, and binding changes with FHIR-26067, but it did not update source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml or source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml. Those authoritative resource definitions still contained the original stale wording before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists implementationguide=ImplementationGuide and structuredefinition=StructureDefinition, so both edited XML files feed the current build. source/versions.html already defines major.minor.patch-label, source/versioning.html already links to versions.html#versions, and FHIR-35169 was resolved Not Persuasive because FHIR-26067 addressed major.minor version codes. Remaining old wording was found only in generated-looking SVG diagrams and was left for normal regeneration rather than manual SVG editing.
reconciliation: Changed the two fhirVersion ElementDefinition definitions to describe values as FHIRVersion code-system codes, covering major.minor release lines and full major.minor.patch versions with optional labels, with examples and a link to FHIR Releases and Versioning.
source_changes: source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml: replaced obsolete StructureDefinition.fhirVersion [publication].[major].[minor] definition with FHIRVersion code-system wording and examples.

source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml: replaced obsolete ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion [publication].[major].[minor] definition with FHIRVersion code-system wording and examples.

related_jiras.note: The same historical implementation commit applied FHIRVersion code-system and version-policy changes that inform this wording.
Resolved Not Persuasive because FHIR-26067 already addressed major.minor version codes, supporting definitions that do not prohibit those codes.
